title: Beyond RGB: Benchmarking and Enhancing MLLMs for Hyperspectral Image Understanding via Training-Free Reasoning Framework
abstract: arXiv:2604.08884v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on RGB image understanding, yet their ability to use spectral evidence beyond the visible range remains largely unexplored. Hyperspectral imagery (HSI) provides dense spectral measurements that reveal material and environmental cues unavailable in RGB, but current MLLMs cannot directly ingest high-dimensional HSI. To study this gap, we introduce HM-Bench, an evidence-grounded benchmark for hyperspectral image understanding with MLLMs. HM-Bench contains 19,337 question--answer pairs from 2,178 hyperspectral samples across 13 task categories, covering general perception, spectral reasoning, and spatial--spectral reasoning. To make HSI accessible to the native image--text interfaces of existing MLLMs, we further propose VSR$^{2}, a training-free Visual--Spectral--Report Reasoning framework. translated_title: 超越RGB：通过无训练推理框架提升多模态大语言模型在高光谱图像理解中的表现
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在RGB图像理解上表现出色，但其利用可见光谱范围之外的谱证据的能力尚未被充分探索。高光谱成像（HSI）提供了密集的光谱测量，揭示了RGB中无法获得的材料和环境线索，但当前MLLMs无法直接处理高维HSI数据。为研究这一差距，我们引入了HM-Bench，一个基于证据的高光谱图像理解基准，用于评估MLLMs。HM-Bench包含来自2,178个高光谱样本的19,337个问答对，涵盖13个任务类别，涉及一般感知、光谱推理和空间-光谱推理。为使HSI适配现有MLLMs的原生图像-文本接口，我们进一步提出了VSR$^{2}$，一种无训练的视觉-光谱-报告推理框架。VSR$^{2}$通过三个对齐视图表示每个HSI样本：一个RGB视图、一个光谱视图和一个报告视图。
tldr: 本文提出了HM-Bench基准和VSR$^{2}$无训练推理框架，首次系统评估并提升了多模态大语言模型在高光谱图像理解中的能力，通过将高维光谱数据转换为对齐的RGB、光谱和报告视图，无需额外训练即可实现高效推理。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HM-Bench benchmark and VSR$^{2}$ training-free reasoning framework, systematically evaluating and enhancing MLLMs' capability in hyperspectral image understanding by converting high-dimensional spectral data into aligned RGB, spectral, and report views without additional training.
